description:
Rotate a saved key

Replaces a saved key with a new key of the same vendor (an own server: a new address or key): sealed like the first, its offers move to it, the old one stops serving within a minute, and a health test runs on the new one. The same key again is a 400. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller. A key another account lists is 409 key_taken; one of this account's other keys is 409 key_already_added. At most 100 new seller keys a day per account, rotations included: past it, 409 limit_reached.

baseUrl.description: custom only: the server's base URL (the same or a new one).

key.description: The new key, of the same vendor (custom: the new bearer key, optional).
